name: Lag Reducer
description: Optional particle draw reduction with a corrected strength scale and an on/off switch.

enabled.name: Enable particle optimization
enabled.description: Master switch. Turn off to restore normal particle drawing.

particle-draw-reduction.name: Particle draw reduction
particle-draw-reduction.description: 0 = off; 1 draws 1/2, 2 draws 1/3, 3 draws 1/4, 4 draws 1/5 of particle draw calls. Higher values may cause visible flicker or hide visual cues.
